recipes.name: Teddy Brûlée inspired by Bob's Burgers
instructions: In a bowl, combine whole wheat flour along with all purpose flour, white granulated sugar, salt, baking powder, and cinnamon. Whisk to combine. - 4 ½ ounces Whole Wheat Flour - 4 ounces All Purpose Flour - 1 ½ ounces White Granulated Sugar - 1 tsp Salt - 1 tsp Baking Powder - 1 tsp Cinnamon
In a separate bowl combine egg with vegetable oil, honey and milk. Whisk to combine and then add to the dry ingredients. - 1 Egg - 1 ½ ounces Vegetable Oil - 3 ounces Honey - 1 ounce Milk
Using a spatula, fold to combine until a rough, semi-firm dough forms. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Divide the dough into two pieces and roll out in between two pieces of parchment paper until it’s almost as thin as possible.

Once rolled out, peel off the top layer of the parchment paper and place on a baking sheet. Brush the whole thing down with about milk. Place in a 350°F oven for about 10 minutes before removing and cutting into graham cracker shapes. Place back in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool for about 30 minutes. - 2 tbsp Milk
In a stand mixer, add water along with powdered gelatin. Whisk to combine. - ½ cup Water - 3 packets Powdered Gelatin

In a small saucepan, combine white granulated sugar along with water, and light corn syrup. Mix to combine and then bring the mixture to a temperature of 240°F. - 1 ½ cups White Granulated Sugar - ½ cup Water - 1 cup Light Corn Syrup

With your whisk attachment attached, slowly start your stand mixer and add the contents from your saucepan SLOWLY. Mix for about 5 minutes, slowly increasing your speed to high. Once mixture resembles a marshmallow consistency, add vanilla extract. - 2 tsp Vanilla Extract

Start with a 9x13 casserole dish and lightly coat with vegetable oil, as well as some parchment paper. Once that is done, dust the whole thing down with powdered sugar. Make sure everything is evenly coated. - Vegetable Oil - Powdered Sugar
Add your marshmallow mixture to the casserole dish and let it sit uncovered for 4 hours. - Marshmallows
Liberally coat your work surface with powdered sugar and turn your marshmallow out on top of the powdered sugar. - Powdered Sugar
Lightly coat a knife in oil and powdered sugar and cut your marshmallows into 1 inch cubes. - Vegetable Oil

Preheat a cast iron skillet in a 400°F oven and then add your chocolate first, followed by the marshmallows. Place in the 400°F oven for 7-10 minutes, rotating halfway through. - Chocolate of your choice - Marshmallows
Serve with graham crackers and enjoy! - Graham Crackers
